## Checklist

- [ ] Source branch is `feature/`, `chore/`, or `bugfix/`; branch guard passes.
- [ ] Specification and task acceptance checks are met, or remaining work is stated.
- [ ] Tests use synthetic fixtures and mocked calls only.
- [ ] No Azure writes, secret retrieval, customer config, or customer output added.
- [ ] PSScriptAnalyzer and Pester checks pass.
- [ ] README reviewed and updated in this PR where status or usage changed.
- [ ] Task register status, percentage, notes, and session log updated.
- [ ] Relevant runbook/schema/generated rule documentation updated.
- [ ] Breaking contracts and any version bump are explained.
